results.content: Next Monday’s programme will include: the screening of the **video *Wien, Vienna*** (2025, 11’13”), created by the German artist for the exhibition; a presentation by **Specker** herself via videoconference; in-person contributions by historians **Annalisa Di Fant**, curator of the Museum of the Jewish Community of Trieste *Carlo e Vera Wagner*, and art historian **Daria Brasca**, who specifically studied the goods’ confiscations in the Port of Trieste. On the occasion of the 21st edition of the Contemporary Art Day AMACI, the major event organised annually by the Association of Italian Contemporary Art Museums to promote contemporary culture, with the support of the Directorate-General for Contemporary Creativity of the Italian Ministry of Culture, in collaboration with the Directorate-General for Public and Cultural Diplomacy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Trieste Contemporanea will propose a *libraryline* conversation on **4 October** at **6 pm** at Studio Tommaseo (Via del Monte 2/1, Trieste) with **Valentina Valentini** on the work of Bill Viola (1951–2024, United States of America).
